question: An engineer performs a Firmware Auto install upgrade through the Cisco UCS Manager. Which two Cisco UCS components are available to be upgraded in the install Server Firmware stage? (Choose two.)
theory: The Install Server Firmware stage of Auto Install upgrades the host firmware packages applied to actual servers in the domain — both Cisco UCS B-Series Blade Servers and Cisco UCS C-Series Rack-Mount Servers that are integrated into and managed by the UCS domain — as opposed to the Install Infrastructure Firmware stage, which instead upgrades the fabric interconnects, I/O Modules, and Cisco UCS Manager. Recognizing that this stage is scoped to server hardware (blade and rack) rather than domain infrastructure is what identifies the correct two components. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Upgrades, Install Server Firmware)
